title: Underlying set sheaf of a constructible module sheaf
statement: Let X be a scheme and Lambda a finite commutative ring. If F is a constructible sheaf of Lambda-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], then forgetting its module structure to abelian groups and then to sets gives a constructible sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The same finite constructible locally closed stratification witnesses the conclusion; no Noetherian hypothesis on X is needed.

source.place: Tags 095E(3), 03RU and 09Z6: forgetting finite module trivializations in the partition argument

proof.text: Unpack the module-constructibility witness and retain its topological stratification, domains, immersions and range equalities. These fields give Scheme.Stratification directly; the explicit constructibility conjunct is redundant because Topology.Stratification already contains isConstructible_stratum. On each stratum apply the first equivalence of finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff to obtain IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf for the module inverse image.

Prove the inverse-image/underlying-set comparison directly. Base change on small etale sites is representably flat; its opposite has filtered costructured-arrow categories (structuredArrowOpEquivalence). The module forgetful functor preserves these filtered colimits, after shrinking the hom universe. Thus leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves identifies forgetting the module presheaf inverse image with the set presheaf inverse image. Compose its sheafification with sheafComposeNatIso, since forgetting preserves sheafification, to obtain the isomorphism of the two sheaf inverse images. The direct module-to-set forgetful sheaf is definitionally the composite through abelian groups in the statement.

For a finite locally constant module sheaf on a stratum, choose its LocallyConstantDatum. Restriction commutes definitionally with sheafCompose, and Mathlib's constant-sheaf composition instance gives constant set sheaves on the same cover. At an algebraically closed point, IsFiniteSheaf.isFinitelyGenerated_sheafFiber and ModuleCat.isFinitelyGenerated_iff give a finitely generated module stalk. Module.finite_of_finite makes this stalk finite over the finite ring. Point.sheafFiberCompIso and Finite.of_equiv transfer finiteness to the underlying set stalk. Finally transport both local constancy and stalk finiteness through the inverse-image comparison (using overPullback.mapIso, Sheaf.isConstant_congr and sheafFiber.mapIso), and package the retained stratification.
